Indeed, embedding the declared number field into \(\mathbb C\) would yield a noninjective polynomial map \(\mathbb C^3\to\mathbb C^3\) with nonzero constant Jacobian determinant. No such example is known; the existence of one remains an open problem, so a genuine counterexample certificate cannot presently be supplied.
